text_block_list.text: One morning, in front of the school gate――

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I had a modeling gig late into the night 
yesterday. Thanks to that, I barely made 
it on time…… *yaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I probably won't be late, so I guess 
I'll take my sweet time getting there.
choice_data_list: Isn't work about to start soon...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Nah, no way— Wait, seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the alarm clock in my room was 
out of sync... *sigh* Gotta hurry. Thanks 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. Well, keeping your cool is 
important no matter what—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the warning bell's already ringing!? 
Whoa, shoot. Did the alarm clock in my 
room get desynced?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, if I run now, can I still make 
it? See ya! Make sure you're not late 
either!
